business_problem: Kantar needed to replace manual, on-premises device management with a cloud-based endpoint model that could improve security, reduce IT effort, and prepare the company for Copilot and AI.
solution_summary: After separating from WPP, Kantar used the transition as an opportunity to rebuild digital workspace operations around cloud management instead of continuing with a legacy Windows 10 environment. The program combined modern endpoint management, identity, provisioning, and cloud PCs so the company could reduce time-intensive engineering work on each device, support employees in offices without on-site IT staff, and establish a secure foundation for generative AI adoption. Key components include Microsoft Intune, Windows 11 Enterprise, Windows 365 Cloud PCs, Entra ID, Windows Autopilot, and Copilot. Kantar reduced device setup effort, improved support for distributed offices, strengthened security using capabilities already in its Microsoft estate, and built a simpler employee experience that is ready for Copilot.

data_flow: New devices can ship from the manufacturer through Windows Autopilot, join Entra ID, and be managed through Intune without hands-on engineering. Windows 365 Cloud PCs help bridge scenarios during the rollout, and the Windows 11 baseline becomes the managed endpoint environment on which Copilot and other AI experiences can safely run.
